research_summary: Merged from 8 projection shards, one per visible A100 GPU.
Regular Marlin base and sequential QLoRA schemes explicitly clear SGLANG_MARLIN_RESERVE_SMS.
Only two-stream QLoRA schemes temporarily set SGLANG_MARLIN_RESERVE_SMS=1 for their Marlin launch/capture.
SGLang csgmv, SGLang Triton segmented-GEMM, and plain Torch matmul LoRA patch paths are measured.
All measurements use activation prewarm, CUDA Graph replay, torch.compile where applicable, and L2 flushing from the benchmark config.
